install.userOwnedExclusion: Only managed pipeline skill tree and pipeline:*.md commands are removed; user-owned files are preserved.
install.postInstall: Synthetic fixture host — invoke via declared command surface.

early_run_handoff.fallback: Discover run_id and events path via pipeline status / run-store inspection (portable baseline).

event_follow.fallback: Follow until terminal via events.jsonl / pipeline logs --events --follow (portable baseline).

reattach.fallback: Re-arm portable events.jsonl follow after cancelled wait.

wait_cancel.fallback: Cancelled wait is never terminal; reattach or re-follow events.jsonl.

material_progress_notify.fallback: stdout and events.jsonl material lines (portable baseline)

terminal_cleanup.fallback: Stop any local follows for this run_id; leave run store intact.

terminal_summary.fallback: pipeline summary <run-id> or terminal stdout summary JSON.
